title: AI Spoke Compass
tagline: Ask plain-English questions about how Norwegian workplaces use AI and what holds them back. An AI agent looks up the answer in official Statistics Norway data and cites every figure.

datasets.name: Statistics Norway table 14944: Obstacles to enterprise AI use by industry and size (2026)
datasets.attribution: Statistics Norway table 14944: Obstacles to enterprise AI use by industry and size (2026), https://www.ssb.no/en/statbank/table/14944 (licence: CC-BY-4.0)
limitations: Automated inspection: Snapshot inspected 2026-11-05; the source may change after this date.
Single year (2026); value column is named '2026'; cross-sectional comparisons only.
Survey of enterprises with 10+ employees; percentages as defined by SSB. The 'Has considered to use AI' row is a share, not an obstacle.

datasets.name: Statistics Norway table 14365: Use of generative AI by sex and age (2024-2026)
datasets.attribution: Statistics Norway table 14365: Use of generative AI by sex and age (2024-2026), https://www.ssb.no/en/statbank/table/14365 (licence: CC-BY-4.0)
limitations: Automated inspection: Snapshot inspected 2026-11-05; the source may change after this date.
Restricted to working-age groups and two measures (private, work use) to avoid SSB missing values ('..') and commas in column names; population survey, not employees of one company.
Only 3 years (2024-2026): describe trends, do not forecast.

tools.name: rank_ai_obstacles
tools.description: Rank the obstacles to AI use (contents) by the share of enterprises citing them, in per cent (column '2026'). Always filter ONE industry (SIC2025), using '_T Total' for all industries, and ONE size class (employed persons, e.g. 'Total' or '100 employed or more'). 'Has considered to use artifical intelligence technology' is a share of enterprises, not an obstacle: report it separately.

params.eval_question: What is the most cited obstacle to AI use among Norwegian enterprises with 100 or more employees?

tools.name: obstacle_by_company_size
tools.description: Compare ONE obstacle (contents) across enterprise size classes (employed persons), in per cent (column '2026'). Always filter ONE industry (SIC2025), using '_T Total' for all industries. The 'Total' group is all sizes combined, not a size class.

eval_filters.contents: Concerns regarding violation of data protection and privacy

params.eval_question: Which enterprise size class most often cites data protection and privacy concerns as an obstacle to AI?

tools.name: obstacle_by_industry
tools.description: Compare ONE obstacle (contents) across industries (SIC2025), in per cent (column '2026'). Always filter ONE size class (employed persons). '_T Total' is all industries combined.

params.eval_question: In which industry do enterprises most often cite lack of relevant expertise as an obstacle to AI?

tools.name: genai_work_use_by_year
tools.description: Percentage reporting use of generative AI tools for professional (work) purposes in the last three months, by survey year (2024-2026). Always filter ONE sex ('Both sexes', 'Females', 'Males') and ONE age group ('16-74 years' for everyone). SSB's base for this percentage is unconfirmed: values exceed SSB's overall 'have used generative AI' share, so they are most likely shares of generative-AI users, not of the population. Say so instead of calling it a share of all people.

metrics: Used generative AI tools for professional (work) purposes
params.eval_question: In which year was work use of generative AI highest among 45-54 year olds?

tools.name: genai_use_by_age
tools.description: Compare age groups on the percentage reporting generative-AI use for work and for private purposes. Always filter ONE year and ONE sex. '16-74 years' is the all-ages total, not an age group. SSB's base for this percentage is unconfirmed: values exceed SSB's overall 'have used generative AI' share, so they are most likely shares of generative-AI users, not of the population. Say so instead of calling it a share of all people.

metrics: Used generative AI tools for professional (work) purposes
Used generative AI tools for private purposes
params.eval_question: Which age group used generative AI for work most in 2026?

example_questions: What are the top three reasons large Norwegian enterprises give for not using AI?
Do bigger companies worry more about privacy and legal clarity than small ones?
Which industry reports the biggest skills gap for AI?
How fast has work use of generative AI grown among 55-64 year olds since 2024?
